name: control-task
description: Canonical main-task anchor; updated only after user messages, never execution state.

interface.shortDescription: Keep the main task anchored to one Codex session.
interface.longDescription: Provides a session-bound control_task_set tool and lifecycle hooks that anchor root and subagent launch tasks across compaction and long tool-driven turns.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set the durable main task for this session.
